editorial: As dusk settles over a lonely lodge, a single blinking camera throws the world into an uneasy standoff. No Signal! (2025) fuses tense family drama with a bumbling robbery, all through the off‑center lens of shy step‑siblings, creating a chilled found‑footage thriller. The film’s apex arrives when the camera captures the criminals’ comedy of errors, turning frayed wires into a heartbeat‑pounding choreography that feels simultaneously dire and darkly funny. Ideal for viewers who crave close‑quarrel suspense infused with off‑beat humor. Yet, a few mid‑scene stretches drag the narrative just before the final showdown.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who enjoy non-linear storytelling.
